scope: Cached diagnostics skip wire lookahead sampling/construction; native src/opin lookahead is still computed after loading the wire map. Thus cached mode does not remove every preprocessing operation.
evidence: bnn_s2_cached_tasks0_r0 process.log: Loading router wire lookahead map 0.04s, Computing src/opin lookahead 0.34s. Both TASKS arms set PARALLEL=1 and reuse identical wire map.
restriction: Do not attribute route differences solely to routing races or claim all preprocessing is absent. This clarification does not change frozen commands, samples, gates or input files.
source_observation: make_router_lookahead selects read() when a cache path is supplied; MapLookahead::read loads wire costs and computes src/opin costs. The TASKS selection occurs in wire-map construction.
